question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence.

He was the __most cleverest__ man I ever knew.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of the superlative form "**most cleverest**."
 
• Superlative adjectives should not be preceded by "**most**" when they already have the superlative suffix "-est".
 
• The correct phrase should be "**cleverest**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in the phrase **most cleverest** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"He was the **cleverest** man I ever knew."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "cleverer,"** – This form is used for the comparative degree, not the superlative.
 
• **Option 3: "more clever,"** – This is the comparative form and cannot be used with "most".
 
• **Option 4: "most cleverer,"** – This is incorrect because "most" should not be used with "cleverer".
